beratung.title: Your personal path to the
beratung.intro: I accompany you step by step on your Thermomix journey:
beratung.promise: Personal, honest and there for you even after the purchase.
beratung.together: Together we find out if the Thermomix is right for you.

step1.title: Contact & Introduction
step1.description: Contact me easily: via website form, WhatsApp or Instagram.
step1.details: We briefly get to know each other by phone and I listen to what you really miss in your daily kitchen routine. This way I can pick you up exactly where you are.

step2.title: Personal Consultation
step2.description: In a personal conversation, online or on-site, we discuss your wishes, your daily routine and your cooking habits.

step3.title: Experience Thermomix live at a Cooking Show
step3.description: At a cooking show, you can experience the Thermomix live with your family and friends. Relaxed at your home!
step3.details: You'll see how versatile and easy cooking can be and get a real feel for the device in your kitchen.

step4.title: Test in Everyday Life
step4.description: If you want, you can also test the Thermomix at home for a few days. I'll simply lend you my device.
step4.details: This way you experience how it will accompany you in everyday life. Family cooking, quick dinner or healthy dishes: You decide what you want to try.

step5.title: Order and Delivery
step5.description: If you've decided on the Thermomix, I'll accompany you through the order and take care of all the details.
step5.details: Together we clarify payment, financing options and delivery dates.

step6.title: Start & Personal Training
step6.description: Shortly before a Thermomix delivery, I'll contact you. When the Thermomix has arrived, I support you in getting started.
step6.details: I show you the most important functions, give you tips for the first recipes and help you feel confident with the device quickly. This way cooking is fun from the start.

afterPurchase.title: More than consultation – personal support
afterPurchase.subtitle: My goal is for you to feel comfortable with your device long-term and integrate it into your daily life with joy.
afterPurchase.outro: From the first conversation until long after the purchase, I'm happy to be there for you.

whatIs.title: What is a Cooking Show?
whatIs.intro: A cooking show means: you see the TM7 in action, not just in pictures.
whatIs.description: We cook a complete menu together. You'll get a feel for how fast, clean and relaxed cooking with the Thermomix can be.
expectations: Tips for everyday life, family & meal prep

important.title: No pressure, just inspiration
important.description: The cooking show is non-binding. You don't have to buy anything, sign anything! You simply take ideas, information and impressions with you.
